sections.Profile:
"Chicago Cubs Triple Play," released by Premier Technology (Gottlieb) in April 1985, is a solid-state pinball machine themed around baseball. Designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Larry Day, it features two flippers, no ramps, and no multiball capabilities.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1985
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Licensed, Baseball, Sports, Solid State, 1980s
